newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonia minister resigns over financial scandal.
newsitem.headline: Macedonia minister resigns over financial scandal.

text.p: Macedonia's prime minister accepted on Wednesday the resignation of Construction Minister Jorgo Sundovski over a pyramid scheme scandal that has rocked the tiny former Yugoslav republic.

Sources in the ruling SDAM alliance said Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski will reshuffle his cabinet next week and dismiss five ministers allegedly involved in the collapse of the TAT financial institution, based in the southern town of Bitola.

The pyramid scheme folded last month with a loss of 112 million German marks ($67 million). Several officials are in custody while investigations proceed. Sundovski denies involvement in the scandal and said he resigned because of "unfounded and tendentious accusations of my involvement in the TAT financial scandal that ruined my reputation and my further work as minister".
Macedonia shares a border with Albania, where the collapse of pyramid savings schemes has led to armed insurrection in much of the country.
But authorities in Macedonia have said other savings houses are safe and they do not fear a chain of bankruptcies similar to the one in Albania.
